cases.name: native-slot-spare-patch
cases.description: Only the edited slot spare model goes to each target; a target with nothing stored starts from all off; a two-role target is skipped.

cases.name: native-slot-spare-off-patch
cases.description: Switching one stored custom slot off sends that slot only, without cost confirmation.

cases.name: native-method-only
cases.description: A method edit sends the method only; every target keeps its stored spare models.

cases.name: native-copy-all
cases.description: With copy-all the earlier full body is sent (marker included).

cases.name: profiles-routes-patch
cases.description: An added specialist and a new default go to each target as a patch; a target already listing it keeps its own description.

cases.name: profiles-routes-remove-and-describe
cases.description: A removal and a description edit need no new authority.

cases.name: slot-merge
cases.description: One edited slot merges over each target; unsent slots keep their declaration, absent ones stay absent.

cases.name: slot-legacy-collision
cases.description: A submitted slot that another target stores as following the delegation model is kept there.

cases.name: slot-copy-all
cases.description: Copy-all sends every slot (the earlier slot map), merged per target.

cases.name: timeout-one-field
cases.description: Only the changed time limit goes to each target; the others keep their own values.
